motion_rule: camera travels down the aisle alongside the wolf every beat, washers and sheets streaming past frame; wolf covers ground in every beat, never planted; one action per beat; wolf head over a third of frame, new shot size each beat; motion across frame, never up-down
character: grey wolf, lean, wet fur, no clothing at all, upright on hind legs with front paws free, fills two thirds of frame height, same look throughout
second_characters: ONE crow and ONE goat, always a shoulder from the lens and crossing frame: the crow at 0.00-0.70, 1.40-2.10 and 4.85-5.65, the goat shoving a second cart past the wolf at 0.70-1.40, 2.10-2.75 and 5.65-6.45
props: ONE white paper envelope, blank on both sides, nothing written on it; ONE wheeled laundry cart heaped with wet washing; ONE wet white sheet; A SWARM of wooden clothespins
prop_continuity: one envelope only, carried the whole way: ripped open, shaken out empty, swept through the light, hurled into the lens; out of the wash it is thinner and see-through
environment: narrow laundry aisle, washers packed both sides, wet sheets hanging low and brushing the lens, wheeled carts along it, wide window blazing daylight at the end
light_events: daylight blazes from the window; a wet sheet swings off the line at 6.45 and rakes a bright band across the wolf

audio.delivery: male voice, weary and venomous, bites off every word, 4.5 syllables per second
audio.pronunciation: zar-PLA-ta, BE-la-ya, nas-TOL-ko, shto, pros-VE-chi-va-yet; latin hints are never spoken
audio.pacing: 0.00-1.40, 1.40-2.75 and 2.75-4.05 each on one breath; first word starts at 0.00; after 4.05 no words, sfx continue

timeline.a: wolf shoves the loaded cart into frame from the left and drives it past the lens, striding after it, jaw working
wolf snatches the envelope off the heap and swings it across frame, walking the cart on, jaw working
wolf strides on holding the envelope into the window blaze, sheets raking past the lens, jaw working
wolf rips the envelope open in a wide sideways tear and shakes it out empty, walking through, jaw working
wolf flings the torn envelope out sideways on a straight paw, walking on, jaw working
wolf sweeps the envelope across the window blaze, light blasting through the paper onto his face, striding past the lens, jaw working
wolf vaults onto the rolling cart and rides it down the aisle, the envelope in his teeth, washers streaming past
the wet sheet whips across frame past the lens and the riding wolf ducks through it
the clothespins fly across frame into the lens, the wolf riding on through the clatter
wolf hurls the envelope into the lens with a shoulder swing, his face showing through the wet see-through paper
wolf rides the cart past the lens shoulder first, the empty envelope trailing

must_appear: the envelope in every beat; ripped open with nothing falling out at 2.10-2.75; light through it at 3.00-4.05; every line spoken, last word by 4.05; the wolf on the rolling cart from 4.05 to the end; the throw into the lens at 6.45
negative_prompt: subtitles, watermark, letterbox, night, dark scene, digits, an inscription, a label, a stamp, garbled or misspelled words, Latin letters, a static camera, a still background, an empty aisle, standing in place, slow motion, drawn-out delivery, foreign accent, two actions at once, a closed jaw while speaking, text overlay, English speech, extra limbs, multiple wolves, clothing on the wolf
